reason: I run three agents a day and context loss is real, but $30 isn't the issue — I need to see it actually work for other platform teams before I install a local daemon that brokers every agent I use, and right now there's nothing on Reddit or GitHub issues to point to.
objection: Setup looks complex — daemon, adapters, MCP servers — and I don't install anything until I've seen it discussed in GitHub issues or Reddit.
would_change_my_mind: A one-command install plus positive threads from other platform teams on Reddit or GitHub.
